messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Proof-based upper bound via combinatorial geometry and Heilbronn-type lemmas

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is exactly 1/50, achieved by the affine image of the 13-point projective plane PG(2,3) scaled to fill the square, and this is optimal by a combinatorial-geometric argument showing that any configuration with all 286 triangle areas exceeding 1/50 forces a Delaunay-type triangulation whose smallest cell area contradicts the Heilbronn upper bound for 13 points."}
